about: William P. Maines is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Houston, Texas. William Maines focuses on Business Litigation issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Insurance Coverage and Professional Liability: Defense.

William Maines received Super Lawyers designation for 2003, 2006 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1984. Before practicing law, he attended law school at St. Mary's University School of Law and graduated in 1984.
